        AutoPuzzle.Value = true
    end
end

-- Finds a clear interaction position around a generator.
-- This prevents another survivor standing on the preferred side
-- from blocking the normal generator interaction.
local function GetClearGeneratorPosition(GeneratorMain)
    local Root = LocalRoot or (LocalCharacter and LocalCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    if not GeneratorMain or not Root then
        return nil
    end

    local GeneratorCFrame = GeneratorMain.CFrame
    local GeneratorSize = GeneratorMain.Size
    local CheckDistance = math.max(4.5, math.max(GeneratorSize.X, GeneratorSize.Z) * 0.5 + 3)

    -- Only use the two sides and the front. Never use the back.
    local Positions = {
        GeneratorCFrame.Position + GeneratorCFrame.RightVector * CheckDistance,
        GeneratorCFrame.Position - GeneratorCFrame.RightVector * CheckDistance,
        GeneratorCFrame.Position + GeneratorCFrame.LookVector * CheckDistance
    }

    local RaycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    RaycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    RaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalCharacter, GeneratorMain.Parent}
    local FallbackPosition = Positions[1]

    for _, Position in Positions do
        local Clear = true

        -- Make sure the player's body would not overlap solid geometry.
        local OccupyingParts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(
            CFrame.new(Position),
            Vector3.new(3, 5, 3),
            RaycastParams
        )

        for _, Part in ipairs(OccupyingParts) do
            if Part.CanCollide then
                Clear = false
                break
            end
        end

        if Clear then
            for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
                if Player ~= LocalPlayer and Player.Character then
                    local OtherRoot = Player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if OtherRoot and (OtherRoot.Position - Position).Magnitude < 4 then
                        Clear = false
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if Clear then
            -- Make sure there is no wall directly between the generator and
            -- the interaction position.
            local Direction = Position - GeneratorCFrame.Position
            local WallCheck = workspace:Raycast(
                GeneratorCFrame.Position,
                Direction.Unit * Direction.Magnitude,
                RaycastParams
            )

            if WallCheck then
                Clear = false
            end
        end

        if Clear then
            return Position
        end
    end

    -- A blocked test should not prevent the automation from trying the
    -- generator. The prompt/interaction retry logic handles the fallback.
    return FallbackPosition
end

                                    end
                                end

                                LocalCharacter:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Position))
                                task.wait(0.15)
                            end

                            local BeforeProgress = ProgressValue.Value

                            for _ = 1, 3 do
                                if not IsActive()
                                    or not LocalCharacter
                                    or not ProgressValue.Parent then
                                    return false
                                end

                                if typeof(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        fireproximityprompt(GeneratorPrompt, 1, true)
                                    end)
                                end

                                pcall(function()
                                    GeneratorPrompt:InputHoldBegin()
                                end)

                                -- Complete the generator directly as well as
                                -- opening its prompt. This keeps Do All
                                -- independent from Auto Generator(s).
                                if RemoteEvent and RemoteEvent:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        RemoteEvent:FireServer()
                                    end)
                                end

                                -- Give the generator up to 3 seconds to actually respond.
                                local WaitStart = os.clock()
                                local LastRemoteFire = os.clock()
                                while os.clock() - WaitStart < 3 do
                                    if not IsActive()
                                        or not LocalCharacter
                                        or not ProgressValue.Parent then
                                        pcall(function()
                                            GeneratorPrompt:InputHoldEnd()
                                        end)
                                        return false
                                    end

                                    if ProgressValue.Value > BeforeProgress then
                                        pcall(function()
                                            GeneratorPrompt:InputHoldEnd()
                                        end)
                                        return true
                                    end

                                    if RemoteEvent
                                        and RemoteEvent:IsA("RemoteEvent")
                                        and os.clock() - LastRemoteFire >= 0.15 then
                                        LastRemoteFire = os.clock()
                                        pcall(function()
                                            RemoteEvent:FireServer()
                                        end)
                                    end

                                    task.wait(0.05)
                                end

                                pcall(function()
                                    GeneratorPrompt:InputHoldEnd()
                                end)

                                -- Small pause before the next open attempt.
                                task.wait(0.15)

                                -- Refresh the prompt in case the generator recreated it.
                                local RefreshedPrompt = Object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
                                if RefreshedPrompt then
                                    GeneratorPrompt = RefreshedPrompt
                                end
                            end

                            return false
                        end

                        -- First try the original clear position.
                        GeneratorOpened = TryOpenFromPosition(TargetPosition)

                        -- If three attempts fail, switch to another clear generator position.
                        if not GeneratorOpened and #GeneratorPositions > 0 then
                            for _, Position in ipairs(GeneratorPositions) do
                                if (Position - TargetPosition).Magnitude > 0.5 then
                                    local Clear = true

                                    for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
                                        if Player ~= LocalPlayer and Player.Character then

                                        end
                                    end

                                    if Clear then

                                        if GeneratorOpened then
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        if not GeneratorOpened then

                                GeneratorPrompt:InputHoldEnd()
                            end)
                            task.wait(0.25)
                        end

                    local CompletionDeadline = os.clock() + 8

                        end

                            if GeneratorPrompt and HasClearPosition then

                                end)
                            end
                        end

                    end

                local KillerAnimator = Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

                -- Patch 200: recognize C00lkidd skins by their model name or
                -- character/skin attributes instead of requiring the model to be
                -- named exactly "c00lkidd".
                local function IsC00lkiddKiller(Character)
                    if not Character then return false end

                    local function Matches(Value)
                        if type(Value) ~= "string" then return false end
                        local Name = string.lower(Value)
                        local Compact = Name:gsub("[%s_%-]", "")

                        if Compact == "c00lkidd"
                            or Compact:find("^c00lkidd")
                            or Compact == "c0llabk1dd"
                            or Compact == "c00lskeleton95"
                            or Compact == "dragondudes3" then
                            return true
                        end

                        return false
                    end

                    if Matches(Character.Name) then return true end

                    for _, AttributeName in {
                        "Killer", "KillerName", "Character", "CharacterName",
                        "Skin", "SkinName", "DisplayName", "ActorDisplayName"
                    } do
                        if Matches(Character:GetAttribute(AttributeName)) then
                            return true
                        end
                    end

                    return false
                end
                -- C00lkidd ABH is triggered by the M1 animation, not attack sounds.
                local C00lkiddM1AnimationId = "121858217776572"
                local C00lkiddM1Tracks = {}

                local RunC00lkiddSoundAutoBlock
                if KillerAnimator then
                    KillerAnimator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(Track)
                        local Animation = Track and Track.Animation
                        local AnimationId = Animation and tostring(Animation.AnimationId or ""):match("%d+")
                        if AnimationId == C00lkiddM1AnimationId then
                            C00lkiddM1Tracks[Track] = true
                            Track.Stopped:Connect(function()
                                C00lkiddM1Tracks[Track] = nil
                            end)
                            task.spawn(function() RunC00lkiddSoundAutoBlock(true) end)
                        end
                    end)
                end

                local function IsC00lkiddM1Playing()
                    for Track in pairs(C00lkiddM1Tracks) do
                        if Track.IsPlaying then return true end
                        C00lkiddM1Tracks[Track] = nil
                    end
                    return false
                end

                RunC00lkiddSoundAutoBlock = function(RequireM1Animation)
                    if not GetValue("AutoBlock") or IsHelplessActive() then return end
                    if IsWallCheckBlocked(Killer) then return end
                    if not IsC00lkiddKiller(Killer) then return end
                    if not LocalCharacter or not LocalCharacter:FindFirstChild("QueryHitbox") or LocalCharacter.Parent ~= SurvivorsFolder then return end
                    local AbilityContainer = MainUI and MainUI:FindFirstChild("AbilityContainer")
                    local BlockButton = AbilityContainer and AbilityContainer:FindFirstChild("Block")
                    if not BlockButton then return end

                    local CustomHitbox = CustomHitboxes["c00lkidd"]
                    local KillerNameLower = Killer.Name:lower()
                    for i = 1, 9 do
                        if IsHelplessActive() or not GetValue("AutoBlock") then return end
                        -- This specific M1 uses animation detection; other listed sounds keep audio detection.
                        if RequireM1Animation and not IsC00lkiddM1Playing() then return end
                        SelfParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalCharacter:FindFirstChild("QueryHitbox")}
                        local Part = Instance.new("Part")
                        Part.Name = "KillerDetectHitbox"
                        Part.Color = BrickColor.new("Really black").Color

                        local BaseHitboxSize = (CustomHitbox and CustomHitbox["Size"] or Vector3.new(5.2, 6, 5.65)) * 2.2
                        local GlobalHitboxAdjustment = GetCurrentHitboxAdjustment("AutoBlockHitboxAllKiller")
                        local IndividualHitboxAdjustment = GetCurrentHitboxAdjustment("AutoBlockHitboxC00lkidd")
                        local TotalHitboxAdjustment = GlobalHitboxAdjustment + IndividualHitboxAdjustment
                        Part.Size = BaseHitboxSize + Vector3.new(TotalHitboxAdjustment, TotalHitboxAdjustment, TotalHitboxAdjustment)
                        Part.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(0.1, Part.Size.X), math.max(0.1, Part.Size.Y), math.max(0.1, Part.Size.Z))

                        local DetectionOffset = CustomHitbox and CustomHitbox["Offset"] or CFrame.new(0,0,-3.5)
                        if GetValue("DragBlock", false) then
                            Part.Size = Part.Size + Vector3.new(0,0,2)
                            Part.CFrame = QueryHitbox.CFrame * DetectionOffset * CFrame.new(0,0,-1)
                        else
                            Part.CFrame = QueryHitbox.CFrame * DetectionOffset
                        end

                        if IsC00lkiddKiller(Killer) then
                            -- Reduce only the forward reach by 2 studs while keeping the rear edge fixed.
                            Part.Size = Vector3.new(
                                math.max(0.1, Part.Size.X),
                                math.max(0.1, Part.Size.Y),
                                math.max(0.1, Part.Size.Z - 2)
                            )
                            Part.CFrame = Part.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1)
                        end

                        Part.CanCollide = false
                        Part.Anchored = true
                        Part.CastShadow = false
                        Part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                        Part.Transparency = AreHitboxesShown() and 0.1 or 1

                        Part.Parent = GetHitboxesFolder()
                        Debris:AddItem(Part, 0.4)

                        local Hitbox = workspace:GetPartsInPart(Part, SelfParams)
                        if #Hitbox > 0 and not IsWallCheckBlocked(Killer) and not IsDragBlockCooldownActive(BlockButton) then
                            if FireSignal and BlockButton then
                                FireSignal(BlockButton.MouseButton1Click)
                            task.defer(function()
                                task.wait()
                                UpdateDragBlockCooldownFromBlockUI(BlockButton)
                            end)
                            elseif GetValue("OfficialGame") and UseActorAbility then
                                UseActorAbility:FireServer("UseActorAbility", {"Block"})
                            elseif UseActorAbility then
                                UseActorAbility:FireServer("UseActorAbility", "Block")
                                UseActorAbility:FireServer("UseActorAbility", {"Block"})
                            end
                            if GetValue("DragBlock", false) and not IsHelplessActive() then
                                DragBlockAttackingKiller(Killer, "DragBlock", true)
                            end
                            break
                        end
                        task.wait(0.02)
                    end
                end

                -- Keep C00lkidd's other audio detections; only 75330693422988
                -- is excluded because it is detected through the M1 animation instead.
                local C00lkiddAttackSounds = {
                    ["80516583309685"] = true,
                    ["84307400688050"] = true,
                    ["82221759983649"] = true,
                    ["105516183226360"] = true,
                    ["124234993291213"] = true,
                    ["128195973631079"] = true

                local C00lkiddSoundConnections = {}

                local function GetC00lkiddSoundAssetId(Sound)
                    if not Sound or not Sound:IsA("Sound") then return nil end
                    return tostring(Sound.SoundId or ""):match("%d+")
                end

                local function WatchC00lkiddSound(Sound)
                    if not Sound or not Sound:IsA("Sound") then return end
                    local SoundId = GetC00lkiddSoundAssetId(Sound)
                    if not SoundId or not C00lkiddAttackSounds[SoundId] or C00lkiddSoundConnections[Sound] then return end

                    local function Trigger()
                        if not Sound.Parent or not Sound.Playing then return end
                        if not GetValue("AutoBlock") or IsHelplessActive() then return end
                        local Now = os.clock()
                        if C00lkiddSoundLastTrigger[Sound] and Now - C00lkiddSoundLastTrigger[Sound] < 0.08 then return end
                        C00lkiddSoundLastTrigger[Sound] = Now
                        task.spawn(function() RunC00lkiddSoundAutoBlock(false) end)

                    C00lkiddSoundConnections[Sound] = Sound:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Playing"):Connect(Trigger)
                    if Sound.Playing then Trigger() end
                end

                if IsC00lkiddKiller(Killer) then
                    for _, Descendant in Killer:GetDescendants() do
                        if Descendant:IsA("Sound") then WatchC00lkiddSound(Descendant) end

                local TreachstoneAttackSounds = {

                local function GetTreachstoneSoundAssetId(Sound)

                local function RunTreachstoneSoundAutoBlock()

                        local IndividualHitboxAdjustment = GetCurrentHitboxAdjustment("AutoBlockHitboxJohnDoe")
                        local TotalHitboxAdjustment = GlobalHitboxAdjustment + IndividualHitboxAdjustment
                        Part.Size = BaseHitboxSize + Vector3.new(TotalHitboxAdjustment, TotalHitboxAdjustment, TotalHitboxAdjustment)
                        Part.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(0.1, Part.Size.X), math.max(0.1, Part.Size.Y), math.max(0.1, Part.Size.Z))

                        local DetectionOffset = CustomHitbox and CustomHitbox["Offset"] or CFrame.new(0,0,-3.5)
                        if GetValue("DragBlock", false) then

                            Part.CFrame = QueryHitbox.CFrame * DetectionOffset * CFrame.new(0,0,-1)
                        else

                        Part.CanCollide = false

                        Part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField

                        Part.Parent = GetHitboxesFolder()

                            elseif UseActorAbility then
                                UseActorAbility:FireServer("UseActorAbility", "Block")
                                UseActorAbility:FireServer("UseActorAbility", {"Block"})
                            end
                            if GetValue("DragBlock", false) and not IsHelplessActive() then

                            break

                local function WatchTreachstoneSound(Sound)

                            local Now = os.clock()

                            if string.lower(Killer.Name or "") == "johndoe" and (AnimationId:match("%d+") == "87347358451124" or AnimationId:match("%d+") == "121778755277919") then

                                        ["noli"] = "AutoBlockHitboxNoli",
                                        ["1x1x1x1"] = "AutoBlockHitbox1x1x1x1",
                                        ["c00lkidd"] = "AutoBlockHitboxC00lkidd",
                                        ["azure"] = "AutoBlockHitboxAzure",
                                        ["treachstone"] = "AutoBlockHitboxJohnDoe",
                                        ["vanity"] = "AutoBlockHitboxSlasher",
                                        ["vanity slasher"] = "AutoBlockHitboxSlasher",
                                        ["combat initiation"] = "AutoBlockHitboxSlasher",
                                        ["combat initiation slasher"] = "AutoBlockHitboxSlasher"
                                    }
                                    local PreviewKillerHitboxKey = IsC00lkiddKiller(Killer) and "AutoBlockHitboxC00lkidd" or (PreviewKillerHitboxKeys[PreviewKillerNameLower] or ("AutoBlockHitbox" .. Killer.Name:gsub("[^%w]", "")))
                                    if AnimType:lower() == "golemslash" then

                                    PreviewHitbox.Size = BasePreviewSize + Vector3.new(TotalPreviewAdjustment, TotalPreviewAdjustment, TotalPreviewAdjustment)
                                    PreviewHitbox.Size = Vector3.new(
                                        math.max(0.1, PreviewHitbox.Size.X),
                                        math.max(0.1, PreviewHitbox.Size.Y),
                                        math.max(0.1, PreviewHitbox.Size.Z)
                                    )

                                    local PreviewOffset = CustomHitbox and CustomHitbox["Offset"] or CFrame.new(0,0,-3.5)
                                    if GetValue("DragBlock", false) then

                                        PreviewHitbox.CFrame = QueryHitbox.CFrame * PreviewOffset * CFrame.new(0,0,-1)
                                    else
                                        PreviewHitbox.CFrame = QueryHitbox.CFrame * PreviewOffset
                                    end

                                    if IsC00lkiddKiller(Killer) then
                                        PreviewHitbox.Size = Vector3.new(
                                            math.max(0.1, PreviewHitbox.Size.X),
                                            math.max(0.1, PreviewHitbox.Size.Y),

                                    PreviewHitbox.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
                                    PreviewHitbox.Transparency = 0.1
                                    PreviewHitbox.Parent = GetHitboxesFolder()

                                if GetValue("AutoBlock") and LocalCharacter and LocalCharacter:FindFirstChild("QueryHitbox") and LocalCharacter.Parent == SurvivorsFolder and MainUI:FindFirstChild("AbilityContainer") and MainUI:FindFirstChild("AbilityContainer"):FindFirstChild("Block") then
                                local CustomHitbox = CustomHitboxes[AnimType:lower()] or CustomHitboxes[Killer.Name:lower()]
                                for i = 1,(IsC00lkiddKiller(Killer) and 9 or (Killer.Name:lower() == "noli" and 10 or 10)) do
                                    SelfParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalCharacter:FindFirstChild("QueryHitbox")}
                                    local Part = Instance.new("Part")

                                    local BaseHitboxSize = (CustomHitbox and CustomHitbox["Size"] or Vector3.new(5.2, 6, 5.65)) * 2.2

                    local Connections = {}

                        local Direction = GetDirection(New.row, New.col, Last.row, Last.col)
                        if Direction == "up" then
                            Direction = "down"
                        elseif Direction == "down" then
                            Direction = "up"
                        elseif Direction == "left" then

                        elseif Direction == "right" then
                            Direction = "left"
                        end
                        if Direction ~= "" and Direction then
                            Connections[Direction] = true
                        end
                    end
                    if Next and New then
                        local Direction = GetDirection(New.row, New.col, Next.row, Next.col)
                        if Direction ~= "" and Direction then
                            Connections[Direction] = true
                        end
                    end
                    return Connections

-- Patch 168: Always read the current ABH NumberValue from the settings folder.
-- Some menu implementations can replace the NumberValue when a slider changes,
-- which would leave the cached Values[] entry pointing at the old value.
function GetCurrentHitboxAdjustment(FeatureName)
    local CurrentInstance = PlusFolderSettings and PlusFolderSettings:FindFirstChild(FeatureName, true)
    if CurrentInstance and CurrentInstance:IsA("NumberValue") then
        return tonumber(CurrentInstance.Value) or 0
    end

    -- Never fall back to Values[] here: a replaced slider instance must not
    -- leave an old individual-killer ABH adjustment active.
    return 0
end

function RichTextGradientColor(Text:string,Colors)
	local Count = 0
    for Char in Text:gmatch(utf8.charpattern) do
        if Char ~= " " then
			Count += 1
		end
	end
	if Count == 0 then return Text end
	local MaxIndex = math.max(1,Count-1)
	local Segments = #Colors-1
	local Result,Used = "",0
    for Char in Text:gmatch(utf8.charpattern) do
		if Char == " " then
			Result..=Char
		elseif Char:byte() >= 128 then
		else
			local T = Used/MaxIndex
			Used += 1
			local Segment= math.min(math.floor(T*Segments),Segments-1)
			Result..=('<font color="#%s">%s</font>'):format(Colors[Segment+1]:Lerp(Colors[Segment+2],T*Segments-Segment):ToHex(),Char)
		end
	end
	return Result
end

local function collidewith(gui1,gui2)
	local gui1_topLeft,gui1_bottomRight = gui1.AbsolutePosition, gui1.AbsolutePosition + gui1.AbsoluteSize
	local gui2_topLeft,gui2_bottomRight = gui2.AbsolutePosition, gui2.AbsolutePosition + gui2.AbsoluteSize
	return ((gui1_topLeft.x < gui2_bottomRight.x and gui1_bottomRight.x > gui2_topLeft.x) and (gui1_topLeft.y < gui2_bottomRight.y and gui1_bottomRight.y > gui2_topLeft.y))
end

function TableValueFind(Table, MatchFn, Seen)
    if type(Table) ~= "table" or type(MatchFn) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end
    Seen = Seen or {}
    if Seen[Table] then
        return nil
    end
    Seen[Table] = true

    for Key, Value in Table do
        if MatchFn(Key, Value) then
            return Value, Key, Table
        elseif type(Value) == "table" then
            local FoundValue, FoundKey, FoundParent = TableValueFind(Value, MatchFn, Seen)
            if FoundKey ~= nil then
                return FoundValue, FoundKey, FoundParent
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function CanPlayOverrideAnim(Character)
    return Character and Character.Parent and GetValue("AnimationChanger") ~= "Original" and ((GetValue("ChangeInLobby") and Character.Parent.Name == "Spectating") or Character.Parent.Name ~= "Spectating")
end

function GetAnimationType(ID)
    for i,v in AllAnimations do
        for animtype,animId in v do
            if type(animId) == "table" then
                for i2,v2 in animId do
                    if type(v2) == "string" and v2:find(tostring(ID)) then
                        return animtype,i,i2
                    end
                end
            else
                if type(animId) == "string" and animId:find(tostring(ID)) then
                    return animtype,i
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function AddOverridenAnimation(ID)
    if LocalCharacter and ID then
        if OverriddenAnimations[ID] then
            return table.unpack(OverriddenAnimations[ID])
        end
        local OverrideFolder = LocalCharacter:FindFirstChild("OverrideAnimation") or Instance.new("Folder", LocalCharacter)
        OverrideFolder.Name = "OverrideAnimation"
        local AnimType,CharName = GetAnimationType(ID) or "Unknown"
        local Animation = Instance.new("Animation")
        Animation.Name = AnimType .. tostring(ID)
        Animation.AnimationId = tostring(ID):find("id") and tostring(ID) or "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=" .. tostring(ID)
        Animation.Parent = OverrideFolder
        Animation:SetAttribute("Overriden",true)
        if LocalAnimator then
            local Track = LocalAnimator:LoadAnimation(Animation)
            OverriddenAnimations[ID] = {Track,Animation}
            return Track,Animation
        end
    else
        return
    end
end

local SupportedOverrides = {"idle","walk","run"}
function UpdateAnim(Humanoid)
    local AnimSelected = GetValue("AnimationChanger")
    if not CanPlayOverrideAnim(LocalCharacter) then return end
    local AnimString
    local Type
    if MainModule["IsSprinting"] and Humanoid.MoveDirection ~= Vector3.zero then
        AnimString = AllAnimations[AnimSelected] and AllAnimations[AnimSelected]["Run"]
        Type = "Run"
    elseif Humanoid.MoveDirection ~= Vector3.zero then
        AnimString = AllAnimations[AnimSelected] and AllAnimations[AnimSelected]["Walk"]
        Type = "Walk"
    else
        AnimString = AllAnimations[AnimSelected] and AllAnimations[AnimSelected]["Idle"]
        Type = "Idle"
    end
    if AnimString then
        local FoundAction = false
        for i,v in Humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
            if v.Animation and v.Animation:GetAttribute("Overriden") then
                v:Stop(0.2)
                continue
            end
            if not v.IsPlaying then
                continue
            end
                local AnimType,Char,Name = GetAnimationType(v.Animation.AnimationId)
                local IsSupported = false
                for i,v in SupportedOverrides do
                    if AnimType and AnimType:lower():find(v:lower()) then
                        IsSupported = true
                    end
                end
                if not IsSupported then
                    FoundAction = v
                end
        end
        local OverrideTrack,Animation = AddOverridenAnimation(AnimString)
        if OverrideTrack and CanPlayOverrideAnim(LocalCharacter) then
            OverrideTrack:Play(not FoundAction and 0.1 or 0.3)
        end
    end
end

        LocalAnimator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(Track)

                local Override = Track.Animation:GetAttribute("Overriden")

                end
                LastAnimOriginalUsed = not Override and Track or LastAnimOriginalUsed
                local AnimType,CharName = GetAnimationType(tonumber(Track.Animation.AnimationId:match("%d+")))
                if not Override then
                    for i,v in SupportedOverrides do

                        for i,v in SupportedOverrides do

        local LayoutOrder = SettingInstance:GetAttribute("LayoutOrder")

        if LayoutOrder and DisplayTitle then
            if SettingInstance:IsA("Folder") then
                local Seperator = Templates.Seperator:Clone()
                Seperator.Name = SettingInstance.Name
                Seperator.LayoutOrder = LayoutOrder * 100 + (TabSectionFolder and TabSectionFolder:GetAttribute("LayoutOrder") * 100 or 0)
                SettingInstance:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LayoutOrder"):Connect(function()
                    if SettingInstance.Name ~= "EnviromentFunctions" then
                        Seperator.LayoutOrder = SettingInstance:GetAttribute("LayoutOrder") * 100 + (TabSectionFolder and TabSectionFolder:GetAttribute("LayoutOrder") * 100 or 0)
                    end
                end)
                Seperator.Title.Text = DisplayTitle
                SettingInstance:GetAttributeChangedSignal("DisplayTitle"):Connect(function()
                    if SettingInstance.Name ~= "EnviromentFunctions" then
                        Seperator.Title.Text = SettingInstance:GetAttribute("DisplayTitle")
                    end
                end)
                Seperator.Parent = Contents
                --[[for i,v in pairs(SettingInstance:GetChildren()) do
                    SetupSettingUI(v,SettingInstance,TableFeature)
                end]]

                local SettingType = Templates:FindFirstChild(SettingInstance:GetAttribute("TemplateType") or string.gsub(SettingInstance.ClassName, "Value", ""))
                for i,Child in pairs(Templates:GetChildren()) do
                    if SettingInstance.Parent.Name:find(Child.Name) then
                        SettingType = Child
                    end
                end
                if SettingType then
                    local ModuleType = ModulesOptions[tostring(SettingType.Name)]

local function HandleUIFeatures(TabName,TabContents)
    local Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    Folder.Name = TabName
    Folder.Parent = PlusFolderSettings
    if not TabContents["TabAttributes"] then
        Folder:Destroy()
        warn(`Failed to create section : {TabName}\nERROR: There is no TabAttributes attached to the section`)
        return
    end
    for Attribute, Value in TabContents["TabAttributes"] do
        Folder:SetAttribute(Attribute, Value)
    end
    for SettingName, SettingData in TabContents do
        task.spawn(function()
            if SettingName == "TabAttributes" then
                return
            end
            if type(SettingData) ~= "table" or type(SettingData.InstanceType) ~= "string" then
                return
            end
            local NewInstance = Instance.new(SettingData.InstanceType)
            local TableEvent = table.clone(SettingData)
            table.clear(SettingData)
            setmetatable(SettingData,{
                __index = TableEvent,
                __newindex = function(Table,i,v)
                    TableEvent[i] = v
                    if i == "DisplayDescription" or i == "DisplayTitle" or i == "LayoutOrder" then
                        NewInstance:SetAttribute("DisplayDescription",type(TableEvent["DisplayDescription"]) == type("") and TableEvent["DisplayDescription"] or "")
                        NewInstance:SetAttribute("DisplayTitle",type(TableEvent["DisplayTitle"]) == type("") and TableEvent["DisplayTitle"] or "Untitled Feature")
                        NewInstance:SetAttribute("LayoutOrder",type(TableEvent["LayoutOrder"]) == type(1) and TableEvent["LayoutOrder"] or #NewInstance:GetAttribute("DisplayTitle"))
                    end
                    if i == "Requirement" then
                        NewInstance:SetAttribute("Requirement",(type(TableEvent["Requirement"]) == type(true) or TableEvent["Requirement"] == type("") and TableEvent["Requirement"]))
                    end
                end
            })
            NewInstance.Name = SettingName
            NewInstance.Value = SettingData.DefaultInstanceValue
            local TableData = HttpService:JSONDecode(ReturnData("Data.txt", true))
            if SettingData["Savable"] and FeatureLoadout["EnviromentFunctions"]["files"]["DefaultInstanceValue"] then
                if TableData[SettingName] ~= nil and NewInstance:GetAttribute("Requirement") ~= true then
                    NewInstance.Value = TableData[SettingName]
                end
                NewInstance:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
                    if NewInstance:GetAttribute("Requirement") == true or not SettingData["Savable"] then
                        return
                    end
                    local TableData2 = HttpService:JSONDecode(ReturnData("Data.txt", true))
                    TableData2[SettingName] = SettingData.DefaultInstanceValue == NewInstance.Value and nil or NewInstance.Value
                    if FeatureLoadout["EnviromentFunctions"]["files"]["DefaultInstanceValue"] then
                        ChangeData("Data.txt",HttpService:JSONEncode(TableData2),true)
                    end
                end)
            elseif not FeatureLoadout["EnviromentFunctions"]["files"]["DefaultInstanceValue"] and SettingData["Savable"] and not WarnedAboutFilesCompatability then
                WarnedAboutFilesCompatability = true
                ColoredPrint("Failed to load a savable feature.\nIf this bothers you then you should use a different executor that supports 'writefile' and 'readfile'", "info", Color3.new(1,0.25,0))
            end
            if SettingData["DisplayDescription"] then
                SettingData.DisplayDescription = SettingData.DisplayDescription:gsub("%(NO FUNCTIONALITY%)", RichTextGradientColor("(NO FUNCTIONALITY)",{Color3.fromRGB(255, 83, 53), Color3.fromRGB(255, 123, 0),Color3.fromRGB(255, 83, 53)}))
            end
            SettingData["Instance"] = NewInstance
            NewInstance:SetAttribute("DisplayDescription",SettingData["DisplayDescription"] or "")
            NewInstance:SetAttribute("DisplayTitle",SettingData["DisplayTitle"] or "Untitled Feature")
            NewInstance:SetAttribute("LayoutOrder",SettingData["LayoutOrder"] or #NewInstance:GetAttribute("DisplayTitle"))
            NewInstance:SetAttribute("Requirement",SettingData["Requirement"])
            if SettingData["ExtraData"] then
                for ExtraDataIndex, ExtraDataValue in SettingData.ExtraData do
                    NewInstance:SetAttribute(ExtraDataIndex, ExtraDataValue)
                end
            end
            NewInstance.Parent = Folder
            SetupSettingUI(NewInstance,Folder,SettingData)
        end)
    end
    SetupSettingUI(Folder)
    return Folder
end

        Handle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 1, 0)
        Handle.Position = UDim2.new(XPosition, 0, 0, 0)
        Handle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Handle.Active = true
        Handle.ZIndex = 101

        Handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)
            if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

                Dragging = true
                DragStart = Input.Position
                StartPosition = AutoBlockToggle.Position

                Input.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                        Dragging = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)

        return Handle
    end

    MakeDragHandle("LeftDragHandle", 0)
    MakeDragHandle("RightDragHandle", 1)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)
        if Dragging and (Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then

            local Delta = Input.Position - DragStart
            AutoBlockToggle.Position = UDim2.new(
                StartPosition.X.Scale, StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
                StartPosition.Y.Scale, StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)
end

scripts.script:
-- PURSUER | FE MOVESET
-- R6 | Delta
-- Based on the tested FE animation method

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris=game:GetService("Debris")
local LP=Players.LocalPlayer

local A={
 Idle="rbxassetid://94895464960972",
 Walk="rbxassetid://100206079439305",
 Run="rbxassetid://138660433982140",

 EnrageStart="rbxassetid://126217710453897",
 EnrageIdle="rbxassetid://88434331204148",
 EnrageMove="rbxassetid://95939236092784",

 Slash="rbxassetid://109667959938617",
 Behead="rbxassetid://126681776859538",
 GashingStart="rbxassetid://129976080405072",
 GashingHit="rbxassetid://81255669374177"
}

local S={
 Swing="rbxassetid://108907358619313",
 Hit="rbxassetid://88582935528044",
 EnrageStart="rbxassetid://139926313168788",
 GashingHit="rbxassetid://110592910502331",
 GashingSwing="rbxassetid://127793641088496"
}

local THEMES={
 {50,"rbxassetid://87452114563440",1},
 {38,"rbxassetid://109532520829464",1},
 {27,"rbxassetid://85055674690742",1},
 {14,"rbxassetid://137123073496980",1.25}
}

local char,hum,root
local tracks={}
local current=nil
local special=nil
local connection
local raging=false
local attacking=false
local themeSound=nil
local themeRunning=false
local themeToken=0
local baseSpeed=16

local function stop(t,f)
 if t and t.IsPlaying then
  pcall(function()t:Stop(f or .08)end)
 end
end

local function stopAll()
 for _,t in pairs(tracks) do
  stop(t,.06)
 end
 tracks={}
 stop(special,.05)
 special=nil
 current=nil
end

-- Same animation method as the tested FE script
local function loadAnim(h,id)
 local a=Instance.new("Animation")
 a.AnimationId=id

 local ok,t=pcall(function()
  return h:LoadAnimation(a)
 end)

 if not ok or not t then
  a:Destroy()
  return nil
 end

 table.insert(tracks,t)
 return t
end

local function playSpecial(id,loop,speed)
 if not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return end

 stop(special,.05)

 local t=loadAnim(hum,id)
 if not t then return end

 t.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
 t.Looped=loop or false
 special=t

 pcall(function()
  t:Play(.05,1,speed or 1)
 end)

 return t
end

local function sound(id,volume)
 if not root or not id then return end

 local s=Instance.new("Sound")
 s.SoundId=id
 s.Volume=volume or 1
 s.Parent=root
 s:Play()

 s.Ended:Connect(function()
  if s then s:Destroy() end
 end)

 Debris:AddItem(s,10)
end

local function locomotion(mode)
 if not hum or hum.Health<=0 or attacking then return end

 local id

 if raging then
  id=(mode=="Idle") and A.EnrageIdle or A.EnrageMove
 else
  id=mode=="Idle" and A.Idle or mode=="Walk" and A.Walk or A.Run
 end

 if not id then return end

 if current and current.Animation
 and current.Animation.AnimationId==id
 and current.IsPlaying then
  return
 end

 stop(current,.08)

 local t=loadAnim(hum,id)
 if not t then return end

 t.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
 t.Looped=true

 current=t

 pcall(function()
  t:Play(.08,1,1)
 end)
end

local function updateMovement()
 if not char or not hum or not root then return end
 if hum.Health<=0 or attacking then return end

 local moving=hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude>.05

 if not moving then
  locomotion("Idle")
  return
 end

 local velocity=Vector3.new(
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X,
  0,
  root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z
 ).Magnitude

 if raging then
  locomotion("Run")
 elseif velocity>baseSpeed+1 then
  locomotion("Run")
 elseif velocity<.5 then
  locomotion("Idle")
 else
  locomotion("Walk")
 end
end

local function dash(power)
 if not root then return end

 local old=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity

 root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=
  root.CFrame.LookVector*power+
  Vector3.new(0,old.Y,0)

 task.delay(.12,function()
  if root and root.Parent then
   local v=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity

   root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=
    Vector3.new(0,v.Y,0)
  end
 end)
end

local function attack(id,snd,dashPower)
 if not hum or hum.Health<=0 or attacking then return end

 attacking=true
 raging=false

 stop(current,.05)

 if dashPower then
  dash(dashPower)
 end

 sound(snd,1)

 local t=playSpecial(id,false,1)

 if t then
  t.Stopped:Wait()
 else
  task.wait(.7)
 end

 attacking=false
 special=nil
 updateMovement()
end

local function gashingWound()
 if not hum or hum.Health<=0 or attacking then return end

 attacking=true
 raging=false

 stop(current,.05)

 local target=nil
 local closest=7

 for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
  if p~=LP and p.Character then
   local r=p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   local h=p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

   if r and h and h.Health>0 and root then
    local d=(r.Position-root.Position).Magnitude

    if d<closest then
     closest=d
     target=p
    end
   end
  end
 end

 local hit=target~=nil

 if hit then
  sound(S.GashingHit,1)

  local t=playSpecial(
   A.GashingHit,
   false,
   1
  )

  local timings={
   {0.33,true},
   {0.60,true},
   {1.10,true},
   {2.15,false},
   {2.983,true}
  }

  local last=0

  for _,data in ipairs(timings) do
   task.wait(data[1]-last)
   last=data[1]

   if not root or not root.Parent then break end

   if data[2] then
    dash(30)
   end
  end

  if t then
   task.wait(.25)
   stop(t,.08)
  end
 else
  sound(S.GashingSwing,1)

  local t=playSpecial(
   A.GashingStart,
   false,
   1
  )

  task.wait(5.25)

  if t then
   stop(t,.08)
  end
 end

 attacking=false
 special=nil
 updateMovement()
end

local function toggleRaging()
 if not hum or hum.Health<=0 or attacking then return end

 if raging then
  raging=false

  stop(special,.08)
  special=nil

  updateMovement()
  return
 end

 raging=true

 stop(current,.05)

 sound(S.EnrageStart,1)

 local t=playSpecial(
  A.EnrageStart,
  false,
  1
 )

 if t then
  t.Stopped:Wait()
 else
  task.wait(1)
 end

 if raging and not attacking then
  special=nil
  updateMovement()
 end
end

local function nearestPlayer()
 if not root then return math.huge end

 local closest=math.huge

 for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
  if p~=LP and p.Character then
   local r=p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   local h=p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

   if r and h and h.Health>0 then
    closest=math.min(
     closest,
     (r.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
    )
   end
  end
 end

 return closest
end

local function stopThemes()
 themeToken+=1
 themeRunning=false

 if themeSound then
  pcall(function()
   themeSound:Stop()
  end)

  themeSound:Destroy()
  themeSound=nil
 end
end

local function startThemes()
 if themeRunning then return end

 themeRunning=true
 themeToken+=1

 local token=themeToken

 task.spawn(function()
  while token==themeToken do

   if not char or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then
    stopThemes()
    return
   end

   if nearestPlayer()>50 then
    stopThemes()
    return
   end

   for i,data in ipairs(THEMES) do
    if token~=themeToken then return end

    if nearestPlayer()>50 then
     stopThemes()
     return
    end

    local s=Instance.new("Sound")
    s.SoundId=data[2]
    s.Volume=data[3]
    s.Parent=root

    themeSound=s
    s:Play()

    if i==4 then
     s.TimePosition=1.355

     while s.IsPlaying
     and token==themeToken
     and nearestPlayer()<=50 do

      if s.TimePosition>=55.281 then
       s.TimePosition=1.355
      end

      task.wait(.05)
     end

     s:Stop()
     s:Destroy()
     themeSound=nil
    else
     s.Ended:Wait()

     if s then
      s:Destroy()
     end

     themeSound=nil
    end
   end
  end
 end)
end

local function createGUI()
 local old=LP.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("PursuerFE")

 if old then
  old:Destroy()
 end

 local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
 gui.Name="PursuerFE"
 gui.ResetOnSpawn=false
 gui.Parent=LP.PlayerGui

 local frame=Instance.new("Frame")
 frame.Size=UDim2.new(0,310,0,220)
 frame.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-155,1,-240)
 frame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(10,12,17)
 frame.BackgroundTransparency=.08
 frame.Parent=gui

 local corner=Instance.new("UICorner")
 corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,14)
 corner.Parent=frame

 local stroke=Instance.new("UIStroke")
 stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(65,70,85)
 stroke.Thickness=1
 stroke.Parent=frame

 local title=Instance.new("TextLabel")
 title.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,38)
 title.BackgroundTransparency=1
 title.Text="PURSUER • FE"
 title.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
 title.TextSize=17
 title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
 title.Parent=frame

 local function button(text,x,y,callback)
  local b=Instance.new("TextButton")
  b.Size=UDim2.new(0,145,0,45)
  b.Position=UDim2.new(0,x,0,y)
  b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(22,25,32)
  b.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
  b.Text=text
  b.TextSize=14
  b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
  b.AutoButtonColor=true
  b.Parent=frame

  local c=Instance.new("UICorner")
  c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,9)
  c.Parent=b

  b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
 end

 button("SLASH",10,45,function()
  attack(A.Slash,S.Swing,28)
 end)

 button("BEHEAD",155,45,function()
  attack(A.Behead,S.Hit,28)
 end)

 button("GASHING WOUND [BUGGED RN]",10,100,function()
  gashingWound()
 end)

 button("RAGING PACE",155,100,function()
  toggleRaging()
 end)

 local info=Instance.new("TextLabel")
 info.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,30)
 info.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,0,170)
 info.BackgroundTransparency=1
 info.Text="Q / E / R / T also work"
 info.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(160,165,180)
 info.TextSize=12
 info.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
 info.Parent=frame
end

local function setup(c)
 char=c
 hum=c:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
 root=c:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

 if connection then
  connection:Disconnect()
  connection=nil
 end

 stopAll()
 stopThemes()

 raging=false
 attacking=false
 baseSpeed=hum.WalkSpeed

 -- Default Animate IDs are also replaced,
 -- matching the tested FE script structure.
 task.wait(.25)

 local an=c:FindFirstChild("Animate")

 if an then
  local idle=an:FindFirstChild("idle")
  local walk=an:FindFirstChild("walk")
  local run=an:FindFirstChild("run")

  if idle then
   for _,v in ipairs(idle:GetChildren()) do
    if v:IsA("Animation") then
     v.AnimationId=A.Idle
    end
   end
  end

  if walk then
   local v=walk:FindFirstChild("WalkAnim")

   if v then
    v.AnimationId=A.Walk
   end
  end

  if run then
   local v=run:FindFirstChild("RunAnim")

   if v then
    v.AnimationId=A.Run
   end
  end
 end

 connection=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
  updateMovement()

  if not themeRunning
  and hum.Health>0
  and nearestPlayer()<=50 then
   startThemes()
  end
 end)

 hum.Died:Connect(function()
  stopAll()
  stopThemes()
  raging=false
  attacking=false
 end)

 task.wait(.2)
 updateMovement()
end

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,gp)
 if gp then return end

 if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Q then
  attack(A.Slash,S.Swing,28)

 elseif input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.E then
  attack(A.Behead,S.Hit,28)

 elseif input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.R then
  gashingWound()

 elseif input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.T then
  toggleRaging()
 end
end)

LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
 task.wait(.5)
 setup(c)
end)

setup(LP.Character or LP.CharacterAdded:Wait())
createGUI()

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Mouse = Players.LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- آی‌دی‌های انیمیشن‌های SoyGOAT
local SOY_BLOCK = 88557287105521
local SOY_CHARGE = 73502073176819
local SOY_PUNCH = 119850211147676

-- آی‌دی‌های انیمیشن‌های Nolly
local NOLLY_IDLE = 110933164243478
local NOLLY_WALK = 132550421221296
local NOLLY_RUN = 105441420067903
local NOLLY_CLICK = 92567970681901
local NOLLY_E = 74955323199805

-- آی‌دی‌های انیمیشن‌های Fire Jason
local FJ_IDLE = 111915677103210
local FJ_WALK = 92337314320765
local FJ_RUN = 86125526846131
local FJ_CLICK = 130958529065375
local FJ_Q = 126727756047566
local FJ_E = 70483423693126
local FJ_R_START = 91775045514793
local FJ_R_IDLE = 114548717236087
local FJ_R_WALK = 113354445309383
local FJ_HIT_R = 119062842291223

-- ساخت GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "CustomAnimGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 220)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 200)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = frame

-- دکمه‌ها
local btnSoyGoat = Instance.new("TextButton")
btnSoyGoat.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 45)
btnSoyGoat.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
btnSoyGoat.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
btnSoyGoat.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
btnSoyGoat.TextSize = 14
btnSoyGoat.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
btnSoyGoat.Text = "SoyGOAT (Off)"
btnSoyGoat.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", btnSoyGoat)

local btnNolly = Instance.new("TextButton")
btnNolly.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 45)
btnNolly.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 65)
btnNolly.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
btnNolly.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
btnNolly.TextSize = 14
btnNolly.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
btnNolly.Text = "Nolly (Off)"
btnNolly.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", btnNolly)

local btnFireJason = Instance.new("TextButton")
btnFireJason.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 45)
btnFireJason.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 120)
btnFireJason.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
btnFireJason.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
btnFireJason.TextSize = 14
btnFireJason.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
btnFireJason.Text = "Fire Jason (Off)"
btnFireJason.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", btnFireJason)

-- متغیرها
local character, humanoid, animator
local soyTrackQ, soyTrackE, soyTrackR
local nollyTrackIdle, nollyTrackWalk, nollyTrackRun, nollyTrackClick, nollyTrackE
local fjTrackIdle, fjTrackWalk, fjTrackRun, fjTrackClick, fjTrackQ, fjTrackE, fjTrackRStart, fjTrackRIdle, fjTrackRWalk, fjTrackHitR

local isSoyGoatEnabled = false
local isNollyEnabled = false
local isFireJasonEnabled = false

local isQOnCooldown = false
local isFCOnCooldown = false
local isEOnCooldown = false
local isROnCooldown = false
local isRActive = false

local function setupCharacter(char)
	character = char
	humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
	
	if animator then
		local oldAnimate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
		if oldAnimate then oldAnimate:Destroy() end
		
		local function loadAnim(id, priority)
			local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
			local success, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
			if success and track then
				track.Priority = priority
				return track
			end
			return nil
		end
		
		-- لود انیمیشن‌های SoyGOAT (بدون ترک کلیک)
		soyTrackQ = loadAnim(SOY_BLOCK, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4)
		soyTrackE = loadAnim(SOY_CHARGE, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4)
		soyTrackR = loadAnim(SOY_PUNCH, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4)
		
		-- لود انیمیشن‌های کامل Nolly
		nollyTrackIdle = loadAnim(NOLLY_IDLE, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)
		nollyTrackWalk = loadAnim(NOLLY_WALK, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)
		nollyTrackRun = loadAnim(NOLLY_RUN, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)
		nollyTrackClick = loadAnim(NOLLY_CLICK, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3)
		nollyTrackE = loadAnim(NOLLY_E, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4)
		
		-- لود انیمیشن‌های Fire Jason
		fjTrackIdle = loadAnim(FJ_IDLE, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)
		fjTrackWalk = loadAnim(FJ_WALK, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)
		fjTrackRun = loadAnim(FJ_RUN, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)
		fjTrackClick = loadAnim(FJ_CLICK, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3)
		fjTrackQ = loadAnim(FJ_Q, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4)
		fjTrackE = loadAnim(FJ_E, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4)
		fjTrackRStart = loadAnim(FJ_R_START, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4)
		fjTrackRIdle = loadAnim(FJ_R_IDLE, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)
		fjTrackRWalk = loadAnim(FJ_R_WALK, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)
		fjTrackHitR = loadAnim(FJ_HIT_R, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4)
	end
end

if player.Character then setupCharacter(player.Character) end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCharacter)

-- مدیریت انیمیشن‌های حرکتی
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not humanoid or not character then return end
	
	if isFireJasonEnabled then
		if nollyTrackIdle and nollyTrackIdle.IsPlaying then nollyTrackIdle:Stop() end
		if nollyTrackWalk and nollyTrackWalk.IsPlaying then nollyTrackWalk:Stop() end
		if nollyTrackRun and nollyTrackRun.IsPlaying then nollyTrackRun:Stop() end
		
		local moveSpeed = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude
		local isShiftHeld = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
		
		local curIdle = (isRActive and fjTrackRIdle) or fjTrackIdle
		local curWalk = (isRActive and fjTrackRWalk) or fjTrackWalk
		local curRun = fjTrackRun
		
		if moveSpeed < 0.1 then
			if curIdle and not curIdle.IsPlaying then curIdle:Play() end
			if curWalk and curWalk.IsPlaying then curWalk:Stop() end
			if curRun and curRun.IsPlaying then curRun:Stop() end
		else
			if isShiftHeld then
				if curRun and not curRun.IsPlaying then curRun:Play() end
				if curWalk and curWalk.IsPlaying then curWalk:Stop() end
				if curIdle and curIdle.IsPlaying then curIdle:Stop() end
			else
				if curWalk and not curWalk.IsPlaying then curWalk:Play() end
				if curRun and curRun.IsPlaying then curRun:Stop() end
				if curIdle and curIdle.IsPlaying then curIdle:Stop() end
			end
		end
	elseif isNollyEnabled then
		if fjTrackIdle and fjTrackIdle.IsPlaying then fjTrackIdle:Stop() end
		if fjTrackWalk and fjTrackWalk.IsPlaying then fjTrackWalk:Stop() end
		if fjTrackRun and fjTrackRun.IsPlaying then fjTrackRun:Stop() end
		
		local moveSpeed = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude
		local isShiftHeld = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
		
		if moveSpeed < 0.1 then
			if nollyTrackIdle and not nollyTrackIdle.IsPlaying then nollyTrackIdle:Play() end
			if nollyTrackWalk and nollyTrackWalk.IsPlaying then nollyTrackWalk:Stop() end
			if nollyTrackRun and nollyTrackRun.IsPlaying then nollyTrackRun:Stop() end
		else
			if isShiftHeld then
				if nollyTrackRun and not nollyTrackRun.IsPlaying then nollyTrackRun:Play() end
				if nollyTrackWalk and nollyTrackWalk.IsPlaying then nollyTrackWalk:Stop() end
				if nollyTrackIdle and nollyTrackIdle.IsPlaying then nollyTrackIdle:Stop() end
			else
				if nollyTrackWalk and not nollyTrackWalk.IsPlaying then nollyTrackWalk:Play() end
				if nollyTrackRun and nollyTrackRun.IsPlaying then nollyTrackRun:Stop() end
				if nollyTrackIdle and nollyTrackIdle.IsPlaying then nollyTrackIdle:Stop() end
			end
		end
	else
		if nollyTrackIdle and nollyTrackIdle.IsPlaying then nollyTrackIdle:Stop() end
		if nollyTrackWalk and nollyTrackWalk.IsPlaying then nollyTrackWalk:Stop() end
		if nollyTrackRun and nollyTrackRun.IsPlaying then nollyTrackRun:Stop() end
		if fjTrackIdle and fjTrackIdle.IsPlaying then fjTrackIdle:Stop() end
		if fjTrackWalk and fjTrackWalk.IsPlaying then fjTrackWalk:Stop() end
		if fjTrackRun and fjTrackRun.IsPlaying then fjTrackRun:Stop() end
	end
end)

-- دکمه‌ها
btnSoyGoat.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isSoyGoatEnabled = not isSoyGoatEnabled
	btnSoyGoat.BackgroundColor3 = isSoyGoatEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(40, 140, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	btnSoyGoat.Text = isSoyGoatEnabled and "SoyGOAT (On)" or "SoyGOAT (Off)"
end)

btnNolly.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isNollyEnabled = not isNollyEnabled
	btnNolly.BackgroundColor3 = isNollyEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(40, 140, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	btnNolly.Text = isNollyEnabled and "Nolly (On)" or "Nolly (Off)"
end)

btnFireJason.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isFireJasonEnabled = not isFireJasonEnabled
	isRActive = false
	btnFireJason.BackgroundColor3 = isFireJasonEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(40, 140, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	btnFireJason.Text = isFireJasonEnabled and "Fire Jason (On)" or "Fire Jason (Off)"
end)

-- کلید Q (Block)
local function useQ()
	if isFireJasonEnabled then
		if isQOnCooldown then return end
		if fjTrackQ and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			fjTrackQ:Play()
			isQOnCooldown = true
			task.spawn(function()
				for i = 18, 1, -1 do
					if not isFireJasonEnabled then break end
					btnFireJason.Text = "Fire Jason (Q CD: " .. i .. "s)"
					task.wait(1)
				end
				isQOnCooldown = false
				if isFireJasonEnabled then btnFireJason.Text = "Fire Jason (On)" end
			end)
		end
	elseif isNollyEnabled then
		-- نولی کلید Q ندارد
	else
		if not isSoyGoatEnabled or isQOnCooldown then return end
		if soyTrackQ and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			soyTrackQ:Play()
			isQOnCooldown = true
			task.spawn(function()
				for i = 25, 1, -1 do
					if not isSoyGoatEnabled then break end
					btnSoyGoat.Text = "SoyGOAT (CD: " .. i .. "s)"
					task.wait(1)
				end
				isQOnCooldown = false
				if isSoyGoatEnabled then btnSoyGoat.Text = "SoyGOAT (On)" end
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- کلید R (Punch)
local function useR()
	if isFireJasonEnabled then
		if isROnCooldown or isRActive then return end
		if fjTrackRStart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			fjTrackRStart:Play()
			isRActive = true
			isROnCooldown = true
			
			task.spawn(function()
				for i = 30, 1, -1 do
					if not isFireJasonEnabled then break end
					btnFireJason.Text = "Fire Jason (R CD: " .. i .. "s)"
					task.wait(1)
				end
				isROnCooldown = false
				if isFireJasonEnabled then btnFireJason.Text = "Fire Jason (On)" end
			end)
		end
	elseif isNollyEnabled then
		-- نولی کلید R ندارد
	else
		if not isSoyGoatEnabled then return end
		if soyTrackR and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then soyTrackR:Play() end
	end
end

-- کلید E (Charge)
local function useE()
	if isFireJasonEnabled then
		if isEOnCooldown then return end
		if fjTrackE and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			fjTrackE:Play()
			isEOnCooldown = true
			task.spawn(function()
				for i = 32, 1, -1 do
					if not isFireJasonEnabled then break end
					btnFireJason.Text = "Fire Jason (E CD: " .. i .. "s)"
					task.wait(1)
				end
				isEOnCooldown = false
				if isFireJasonEnabled then btnFireJason.Text = "Fire Jason (On)" end
			end)
		end
	elseif isNollyEnabled then
		if isEOnCooldown then return end
		if nollyTrackE and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			nollyTrackE:Play()
			isEOnCooldown = true
			
			task.delay(3, function()
				if nollyTrackE and nollyTrackE.IsPlaying then
					nollyTrackE:Stop()
				end
			end)
			
			task.spawn(function()
				for i = 5, 1, -1 do
					if not isNollyEnabled then break end
					task.wait(1)
				end
				isEOnCooldown = false
			end)
		end
	else
		if not isSoyGoatEnabled or isEOnCooldown then return end
		if soyTrackE and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			soyTrackE:Play()
			isEOnCooldown = true
			
			task.delay(3, function()
				if soyTrackE and soyTrackE.IsPlaying then
					soyTrackE:Stop()
				end
			end)
			
			task.spawn(function()
				for i = 5, 1, -1 do
					if not isSoyGoatEnabled then break end
					task.wait(1)
				end
				isEOnCooldown = false
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- کلیک موس / M1 (برای سویی‌گوت هیچ کاری انجام نمی‌دهد)
Mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
	if isFireJasonEnabled then
		if isRActive then
			if fjTrackHitR and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				fjTrackHitR:Play()
				isRActive = false
			end
		else
			if isFCOnCooldown then return end
			if fjTrackClick and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				fjTrackClick:Play()
				isFCOnCooldown = true
				task.spawn(function()
					task.wait(2)
					isFCOnCooldown = false
				end)
			end
		end
	elseif isNollyEnabled then
		if isFCOnCooldown then return end
		if nollyTrackClick and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			nollyTrackClick:Play()
			isFCOnCooldown = true
			task.spawn(function()
				task.wait(2)
				isFCOnCooldown = false
			end)
		end
	else
		-- حالت سویی‌گوت روشن باشد هم با کلیک هیچ اتفاقی نمی‌افتد
		return
	end
end)

-- کیبورد
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then useQ()
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then useR()
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then useE() end
end)
